stories.title: Papa Leone in Francia, l'ultima tappa a Metz: "Non si può parlare d'Europa senza cristianesimo"

en.title: Pope Leo in France, final stop in Metz: "One cannot speak of Europe without Christianity"
en.summary: Pope Leo concluded his French visit in Metz with an interfaith appeal for peace and dialogue, marking a day dedicated to Robert Schuman, a European Union founder. French President Macron attended the ceremony and called for Europe to resist nationalism.

stories.title: Perizia su morte Rossi, 'aggredito da più persone, tentava di difendersi'

en.title: Autopsy on Rossi death: 'attacked by multiple people, attempted to defend himself'
en.summary: Initial findings from a simulation indicate the deceased was held outside a window before losing grip. The examination suggests multiple assailants were involved in the incident.

stories.title: Valditara, su decreto scuola con il Quirinale 'interlocuzione molto positiva'

en.title: Valditara, on school decree with Quirinal 'very positive dialogue'
en.summary: An education official reported positive discussions with the presidential office regarding a school decree, emphasizing the need to prevent segregation in educational institutions.

stories.title: Il fuori programma di papa Leone: sul volo per Metz siede in cabina di pilotaggio

en.title: Pope Leo's unscheduled moment: sits in cockpit on flight to Metz
en.summary: During his flight to Metz, Pope Leo visited the cockpit of his aircraft, which was escorted by French Air Force Rafale fighter jets.

stories.title: Decreto scuola, Valditara: "Con Quirinale interlocuzione molto positiva"

en.title: School Decree, Valditara: "Very positive dialogue with Quirinale"
en.summary: The education minister defended a cap on foreign students in classrooms and downplayed text modifications, while opposition parties, unions, and school principals remained critical of the decree.

stories.title: Legale genitori Regeni, stare qui è una vittoria ma non ci accontentiamo

en.title: Regeni parents' lawyer: staying here is a victory but we are not satisfied
en.summary: The lawyer representing the parents of Regeni stated that Egypt made extensive efforts to prevent the trial from proceeding.

stories.title: David Rossi aggredito da almeno 2 persone, tentava di difendersi: le prime valutazioni della perizia

en.title: David Rossi assaulted by at least 2 people, was attempting to defend himself: initial expert assessment findings
en.summary: A parliamentary commission commissioned a reconstruction in Rome of the events surrounding the death of the former MPS communications chief, with preliminary expert analysis indicating he was attacked by multiple assailants.

stories.title: Dove, quando, perché e i prezzi: tutto quello che c’è da sapere sul tetto ai carburanti

en.title: Where, when, why and prices: everything you need to know about the fuel price cap
en.summary: A fuel discount program began today at Eni's 6,200 service stations and half of Ip-branded stations, with price reductions also being studied for Esso outlets.

stories.title: Tetto ai prezzi dei carburanti ai distributori Eni: il momento in cui si aggiornano le tariffe

en.title: Price cap on fuel at Eni distributors: the moment when tariffs are updated
en.summary: Eni has implemented a price ceiling on fuel at its distribution stations. IP, a subsidiary of Azerbaijan's Socar group, is also making moves in the fuel distribution sector.

stories.title: Caccia francesi affiancano l’aereo di Papa Leone XIV: la scorta in volo da Lourdes a Metz

en.title: French fighter jets flank Pope Leo XIV's aircraft: escort in flight from Lourdes to Metz
en.summary: French Air Force fighters escorted Pope Leo XIV's aircraft during his transfer from Lourdes to Metz as the final leg of his apostolic visit to France. The pontiff continued his visit with meetings and a cathedral mass.

stories.title: I tuffi dal balcone a picco sul mare: a Polignano l'ultima tappa del Cliff Diving World Series

en.title: Cliff diving from the balcony overlooking the sea: Polignano hosts the final stage of Cliff Diving World Series
en.summary: Polignano hosted the final event of the Cliff Diving World Series, where Iffland and Heslop won the seasonal titles, while Carlson and Prygorov claimed victory in the Italian competition.

stories.title: Dal balcone al mare, voli da 27 metri: a Polignano lo spettacolo dei tuffi estremi ripreso dal drone

en.title: From balcony to sea, dives from 27 meters: Polignano showcases extreme diving filmed by drone
en.summary: Polignano a Mare hosted the final Cliff Diving World Series event with dives from 21 and 27 meters, attracting approximately 10,000 spectators. Molly Carlson and Oleksiy Prygorov won the individual competitions, while Rhiannan Iffland and Aidan Heslop secured world titles.

en.title: Work-life balance certification launches
en.summary: Certifying bodies authorized to issue work-life balance attestations to companies are being announced today. Companies can receive tax relief of up to 50,000 euros annually for family-friendly workplace policies.

stories.title: Scatto dell’export extra-Ue, con Svizzera, Cina e Usa

en.title: Surge in exports outside EU, with Switzerland, China and USA
en.summary: Italian exports to non-EU countries grew 16.1 percent year-over-year in August, driven notably by increased shipments to Switzerland, China, and the United States.

stories.title: Nell’avanzata digitale gli incontri reali acquistano valore

en.title: In digital advancement, in-person meetings gain value
en.summary: The third edition of the States General of Events highlighted how physical gatherings are becoming increasingly valuable amid ongoing digital transformation.

stories.title: Avatar, mascotte e gemelli: il mondo delle persone sintetiche

en.title: Avatars, mascots and twins: the world of synthetic people
en.summary: Artificial intelligence is evolving from a creative tool into a decision-making infrastructure, enabling new models for testing and interaction between brands and consumers.

stories.title: Benzina e diesel, anche Ip fisserà limiti ai prezzi

en.title: Petrol and diesel, Ip will also set price limits
en.summary: Socar is following Eni's example by implementing price caps on petrol and diesel across its Ip distribution network.
